messages:
emily: newbie here, following the Docker quickstart for sample-app and the first generation call keeps failing with 502 while the console shows "Provisioning workspace" for ages. sample app logs show repeated auth retries. anyone know if this is expected?

juan: not expected for a normal quickstart. usually workspace provisioning is fast but sometimes billing webhook delivery lags and the workspace stays in a pending state. the SDK will hit 401 until the workspace is active which looks like an auth bug.

emily: exact CLI output when creating workspace:
```
POST /v1/workspaces -> 202
{ "id": "wk_test_89", "status": "pending_provision" }
```
then sample-app logs: 
```
sample-app | WARN auth refresh failed: 401
sample-app | INFO retry auth (attempt 2)
sample-app | ERROR downstream request failed: 502 Bad Gateway
```

ops-bot: infra incident 2026-03-23T14:02:11Z - billing-webhook timeouts spike (10m) - auto-retry queued job=wbk_retry_104

juan: two angles: infra should reduce webhook timeouts; SDK should treat create->202 + immediate 401/502 as transient on firstcall. current SDK retries too aggressively which amplifies load.

olivia: quick UX mitigation: quickstart README should show the provisioning state and recommend polling until status==active or wait ~60s before first generation. also include a helpful error message in the sample app when it sees 202->401 flow.

emily: can we add a small polling snippet in the sample app so new users don't hit this? busy devs wont read an aside in the README.

juan: good idea. I'll PR a small helper: poll /v1/workspaces/{id} with exponential backoff (500ms -> 1s -> 2s -> 5s) and only call the generation endpoint when status==active or after a 20s soft timeout with a friendly message.

devx-bot: created issue #8215 (sdk): handle provisional-workspace semantics and extend backoff on firstcall 401/502

olivia: ops pushed a billing webhook retry patch, should reduce stucks. emily, try again in a few minutes and ping if still broken.

emily: re-ran after 4m and the workspace became active; first call succeeded. leaving notes: sample app should surface a clearer onboarding state, and SDK should avoid immediate hard failures on this specific race. :raised_hands:

juan: for SDK backlog: detect sequence create(202)->firstcall(401|502) and surface a `onboard_pending` telemetry tag; implement jittered exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 5s) before surfacing final error. also update docs and quickstart to show the polling snippet.

olivia: filing a docs PR now + adding a short troubleshooting blurb in the console error modal so end-users see actionable steps.
